In [[geometry]], the '''truncated order-6 pentagonal tiling''' is a [[Uniform tilings in hyperbolic plane|uniform]] tiling of the [[Hyperbolic geometry|hyperbolic plane]]. It has [[Schläfli symbol]] of t<sub>1,2</sub>{6,5}.

|colspan=2|An alternate construction exists from the [(5,5,3)] family, as the omnitruncation t<sub>012</sub>(5,5,3). It is shown with two (colors) of [[decagon]]s.
|}

== Symmetry ==
The dual of this tiling represents the fundamental domains of the *553 symmetry. There are no mirror removal subgroups of [(5,5,3)], but this symmetry group can be doubled to [[652 symmetry]] by adding a bisecting mirror to the fundamental domains.
